What's Next
Story Goals
Rent's coming due and I've got next to nothing. No money, no roof — I need work, fast.
💡 Odd jobs, anyone who'll pay — start asking around.
I'm new under this roof. Give it a week — get to know the people I'm living with: Frank, his wife Diana, and Jake.
💡 Settle in. A week here and the house stops being a place you're visiting.
Diana keeps bringing up church. The first Sunday service with her would count for something in a town this small.
💡 Go with Diana to the first Sunday service.
Ugh, I really need a shower.
Ryan
Ryan's out in the yard most days. Maybe I should help him.
🎯 To advance:
◯ Ryan trust — 0 / 10
Frank
I'm new under this roof. Frank watches me and pretends he isn't.
🎯 To advance:
◯ Maya's corruption — 0 / 25
💡 He's around the house all day. I notice that.
Jake
Jake stays in his room. Maybe if I look right, he'll notice me. Or maybe walking past at the right moment is enough.
💡 Two ways in: keep my beauty up (Shower / Sketch in my room) and he'll eventually look up — or pass his door looking my best, and catch his eye in the moment.
